scenes.description: Rapid match pulse opener: dark tactical field lines sweep in, TACTIC mark flashes briefly, club crests enter from opposing depth planes, then lock around the final-score context without holding as a static card.
scenes.framing: Full vertical frame with central score hierarchy and peripheral crest movement; no boxed card.
scenes.movement: Fast masked reveals, shallow parallax, restrained punch-in, line sweeps synced to beat.
scenes.transition_in: Cold open with one-frame impact and tactical-line draw-on.
scenes.transition_out: Whip/masked aperture into live goal footage.
scenes.overlay_notes: Arabic Thmanyah typography, minimal competition/round text, score remains readable but not dominant over motion.
scenes.shot_intent: Establish match identity and energy immediately without becoming a static social card.
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns the teams, competition context, and that Al Wasl won 2-0.

scenes.description: First goal carried by the original match clip. Footage is visually primary and fills the portrait canvas through an intelligent 16:9 treatment: sharp center action with subtle extended/blurred environment only where needed.
scenes.framing: Live footage occupies at least 78% of perceived frame area; compact lower-third only after the decisive action begins.
scenes.movement: Source motion untouched; minimal dynamic crop tracking and a short score pulse after goal moment.
scenes.transition_in: Masked whip from opener into full-motion source.
scenes.transition_out: Commentary tail preserved; quick luminance flash and directional wipe into second goal.
scenes.overlay_notes: 11' مهدي طارمي — الوصل; assist نيكولاس خيمينيز. Lower-third max ~18% frame height. No oversized score box.
scenes.shot_intent: Let the real football moment carry emotion and credibility.
scenes.information_role: Viewer sees the first scoring action and scorer identity.

scenes.description: Second goal carried by the original match clip with a distinct transition vocabulary from goal one. Puertas identity appears only after the decisive action is visible.
scenes.framing: Footage again dominates the portrait canvas; action-safe crop prioritized over decorative graphics.
scenes.movement: Subtle crop follow; scoreboard pulse and thin kinetic accent synchronized with crowd/commentary peak.
scenes.transition_in: Directional energy wipe matched to ball/action flow.
scenes.transition_out: Freeze-energy echo for a few frames, then geometry fractures into the statistics field.
scenes.overlay_notes: 45+1' كاميرون بويرتاس — الوصل. Compact name/minute treatment only.
scenes.shot_intent: Deliver the second decisive match beat while keeping the package feeling editorial rather than templated.
scenes.information_role: Viewer sees the second goal and scorer identity.

scenes.description: Match Pulse statistics sequence. One metric at a time uses a distinct motion metaphor instead of repeated cards: possession split field, xG dual energy rails, shots as tactical strike trails, shots-on-target as goal-target hits, big chances as penalty-box pulses, corners as corner-arc sweeps.
scenes.framing: Full-frame motion graphic environment with clear home/away sides; only one primary statistic visible at a time.
scenes.movement: Values count from zero; geometry physically fills to final values; transitions inherit direction from previous metric so the section feels continuous.
scenes.transition_in: Goal footage fragments into tactical pitch coordinates.
scenes.transition_out: Final corner arcs collapse into a vertical light seam that opens the player hero.
scenes.overlay_notes: Exact values only: possession 46/54; xG 1.57/2.57; shots 19/13; SOT 4/6; big chances 1/2; corners 6/9. Team identity remains consistent and labels never swap sides.
scenes.shot_intent: Turn raw match data into expressive motion moments rather than a static dashboard.
scenes.information_role: Viewer understands that Baniyas produced more shots while Al Wasl had stronger xG, shots on target and big chances.

required_assets.description: Al Wasl crest for side identity

scenes.description: Cameron Puertas player-of-the-match hero reveal. Player image enters through masked depth separation; rating 8.3 lands as the visual anchor while supporting stats orbit/reveal in staggered motion rather than uniform boxes.
scenes.framing: Player occupies roughly half the frame with head/body protected from text; stat clusters use negative space around silhouette.
scenes.movement: Masked vertical reveal, slow hero push-in, light sweep across player edge, rating count-up, supporting stats stagger by importance.
scenes.transition_in: Vertical seam reveal from stats environment.
scenes.transition_out: Player and stats recede in parallax as final-score lockup advances.
scenes.overlay_notes: Use provided player image as-is if transparency is valid; if white background exists, flag as asset-quality issue rather than hide it with a fake crop. Stats: 1 goal, 2 key passes, 55/62 passes, 89%, 76 touches, xG 0.07, xGOT 0.74.
scenes.shot_intent: Create the emotional visual peak and give the match a recognisable human hero.
scenes.information_role: Viewer learns why Puertas is the standout player.

scenes.description: Short full-time resolve: final score, crests and TACTIC logo settle with one clean brand sting; no extra CTA clutter.
scenes.framing: Centered score with balanced crests; TACTIC brand secondary but unmistakable.
scenes.movement: Controlled scale settle, final gold line draw, brief logo sting.
scenes.transition_out: Hard clean fade to black on music resolve.
scenes.overlay_notes: بني ياس 0 — 2 الوصل. Keep typography large and simple.
scenes.shot_intent: Close decisively and leave the score and TACTIC identity in memory.
scenes.information_role: Viewer leaves with final result and publisher identity.

metadata.anchor_rules: Real goal footage is primary in goal scenes; graphics must never reduce decisive action to a small floating window.
metadata.support_rules: Graphics exist only to identify, compare, transition or emphasize; no decorative card stacks.
metadata.safe_zones: Keep critical Arabic text and logos inside central 86% width and away from top/bottom social UI zones.
metadata.variant_rules: Primary deliverable is 1080x1920 only for this test; no alternate aspect ratios are required.
metadata.overlay_density_limits: Goal scenes: one compact lower-third maximum. Statistics: one dominant metric at a time. MOTM: rating plus no more than three simultaneous secondary stat groups.
